verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service with its own Dashboard, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents incorporation, legal documents, EIN and 83(b) filing, equity setup, SAFEs and perks, but nothing about AI-generated insights or suggestions. The checklists and filing reminders that users mention are workflow features, not AI analysis of the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
